notes.title: Devlog News
notes.notes: [p]This DEMO VERSION update brings a mix of optimizations, new content, bug fixes, and quality-of-life improvements. Here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p]Optimization – improved performance across several systems for smoother gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]New Miniboss – a challenging miniboss has been added to the arena[/p][/*][*][p]Marker for Long-Eared – now you may control'em![/p][/*][*][p]Collision Fix – resolved an issue where players could be pushed through walls or the floor[/p][/*][*][p]Reward Notifications – added encouraging notifications for player achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Settings & Menu Update – fixed a bug with quality settings not saving properly, added additional graphics options, and refreshed the in-game ESC menu[/p][/*][*][p]Drone Support Ability – after death, drones can now heal teammates by using LMB[/p][/*][*][p]Long-Eared Interaction – yes, you can now kick them...[/p][/*][*][p]UI Improvements – minor polish and adjustments to interface elements for a cleaner experience[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004130/1b62e5b9b5a0ee384eaf571883d0a1b0a1f7f59c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004130/f7145cf4fc840acd555b593db59e494655676843.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: DEMO reveal
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that the demo of Ironsand is now available on Steam.

Main features of the demo version:
[list]
[*] Three maps with unique Boss Mechs
[*] A huge number of Sci-fi guns and other equipment
[*] Multiple characters and unique active skills
[/list]
Help Long-eared to get rid of the invaders from the Cult of the Iron God!

[h2]Patchnote May 12[/h2]
[list]
[*] Now, when selecting a weapon, you can choose a damage bonus
[*] Fixed sound volume and balance
[*] Fixed a camera bug after cutscenes
[*] Fixed a player death bug during cutscenes
[*] Fixed an invitation bug
[*] Fixed a bug with player death in mid-air
[*] Added key binding in the Lobby Menu
[*] Added features to 4 characters
[*] Added 2 new characters
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest #2
notes.notes:
We are glad to launch the second version of the open playtest of our game. What has changed:

* We have made a standard gameplay loop. No more rebirths after death

* Improved the difficulty so that you can defeat the first Titan without any problems

* Added a new mission and a new map with a second Titan

* Added resources to the game that need to be collected for meta-leveling

* Finally, you can get to know the people of Long-eared!

We hope that the game will bring you pleasure! If you see any mistakes or just decide to share your impressions of the game, text to our discord or leave comments under this news

notes.title: The First Playtest is over
notes.notes:
[h2]The First Playtest is over![/h2]

Yesterday we closed Playtest #1. Many thanks to everyone who played this version of the game! We've collected important statistics and are preparing to launch Playtest #2 in 2-3 weeks

What to expect in Playlist #2:
[list]
[*] A new level and a titan
[*] New weapons and enemies
[*] Different game cycle (classic for roguelikes)
[*] The beginning of the game is going to be way easier
[/list]
We are also finishing shooting a narrative video that tells about the beginning of the conflict between the Cult of the Iron God and the Galactic Union. And also, we will show how Shushas lived before the arrival of the invaders
Stay tuned!

notes.title: PLAYTEST is now available!
notes.notes:
Hello fellas!
Today is a giant step for our new project, we are glad to present you the first public version of the game. We've got a lot of plans for the future of Ironsand, but for now you may request an access for a Playtest
Please share your feedback, it's very important for us to find the right path of development and promotion of our newborn child!

[h2]February 25 Update[/h2]
Added training mode

[h2]February 19 Update[/h2]
[list]
[*] The beginning of the game has been significantly simplified
[*] The battle with Titan on the contrary became more complex and colorful
[*] Updated visuals, some models and sounds
[*] Fixed several small bugs
[/list]
[h2]How to play[/h2]
[list]
[*] Choose your character and ability for a better game
[*] In the lobby scene, you can make character and weapon upgrades and unlock new abilities
[*] When you completely destroy or cut an enemy, resources will drop out of them
[*] Green flask - healing. Red flask - one charge of the ability
[*] Look for and activate “improvement stations” on the location, they give you access to improved weapons
[*] On the location you will encounter 2 very strong enemies: an intermediate boss and a Titan. Defeating them will give you resources for meta pumping
[*] During the fight with Titan you must destroy his turrets. After that, try to kill one of the pilots inside the Titan. Killing all the pilots will destroy the Titan and bring you Victory
[*] After the character dies, you play as a drone. Click on the LMB to drop the health kit. Click on the mouse wheel to select the target
[*] If you can't defeat the Titan - lower the difficulty level or try upgrading your weapon, character or abilities
[/list]
